integrity_issues.issue: read consensus().repeatWarning, which consensus() no longer sets (the guard was reverted to measured-not-offered), so a rerun printed G2 MET where the committed output says NOT MET; fixed to call repeatGuard itself. The committed output was right.

doc_friction.issue: Flagship next: was at 1999 of 2000 characters, so any replacement longer than the item it replaces needs a --park first; the hint says so, which helped, but every run on this flagship now pays this step.

has-data/ (the HAS 2023 fetch dir named by eval/has-fetch.sh, CC BY-NC-SA, must never be committed) was not ignored; a git add -A in the venture would have committed 1.9 M points of non-redistributable data. Added has-data/ and utsa-data/.

The preflight's build copies git-ignored local data dirs (here utsa-data/, a fetched eval set) into the site and failed on a .ppt inside it; CI never sees those dirs. Moving the eval data out of the venture fixed it. Eval fetch scripts that default to a dir inside the venture (tssb-data, has-data, utsa-data) will keep tripping this; the build could skip ignored paths.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
